Subject: Pilot evaluation: scope, performance KPIs & next steps

Thanks again for the time today — good alignment on what success looks like for Syraff's extraction/normalization pipeline. Summary and proposed POC plan below so everyone has a single source of truth. Please reply with any changes; we'll lock and spin up the sandbox once we have signoff.

High-level POC goals (3-week focused run):
- Validate quality and latency on real Syraff workloads for the extraction model (document->structured rows).
- Measure throughput at targeted concurrency to estimate cost and capacity for production.
- Verify integrations (S3 ingestion, KV caching for repeated document prefixes) and simple fallback routing for high-latency cases.

Proposed success criteria (quantitative):
- Latency: p50 < 80ms, p95 < 220ms for 512-token average requests in the Redwood sandbox.
- Throughput: sustain 45-60 RPS with 95% success rate (no OOMs / retries) during 10-minute sustained windows.
- Cost: effective cost/token <= $0.0028 token (billing estimate) at expected compression/quantization in steady-state.
- Quality: end-to-end extraction precision >= 88% and recall >= 85% on Syraff holdout; hallucination rate <= 2% measured by the evaluation harness.

Operational gates and ownership:
- Data ingestion & sample sets: Syraff (Morgan, TJ) to upload 2k representative documents + a 200-doc holdout to the shared S3 bucket by Mon 07/05.
- Smoke validation (week 0): Redwood (Ben) to run a smoke suite and report infra/config notes within 48h of dataset availability.
- Evaluation harness & metrics (week 1): Redwood (Karthik) to instrument latency/throughput collectors and provide the evaluation_template.xlsx.
- Cost estimate & autoscale plan (week 2): Redwood (Aisha + Ben) to deliver a cost projection and recommended autoscale/batching profile.

Next steps (action items):
1) Morgan/TJ: confirm dataset upload timeline and provide S3 path + sample file by EOD 07/05.
2) Ben: provision sandbox cluster and share access/keys (target 07/06).
3) Karthik: drop evaluation_template.xlsx and a short runbook (attached) into the Drive link; call out expected log hooks for your devs.
4) Aisha: schedule a 30-min kickoff for Wed 07/07 to run through onboarding and the test matrix.

Attachments: evaluation_template.xlsx (spreadsheet for metrics), sample_payloads.csv (sample ingestion payloads), security-questionnaire-syraff.pdf (filled with baseline answers).

Best,
